package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/catalog"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// TrackRelationsHandler handles track-level relations.
type TrackRelationsHandler struct {
	Validator     *validator.Validate
	AddLevelUC    catalog.AddTrackLevel
	DeleteLevelUC catalog.DeleteTrackLevel
	ReplaceUC     catalog.ReplaceTrackLevels
}

// LevelRelationsHandler handles level-course group relations.
type LevelRelationsHandler struct {
	Validator     *validator.Validate
	AddGroupUC    catalog.AddLevelCourseGroup
	DeleteGroupUC catalog.DeleteLevelCourseGroup
	ReplaceUC     catalog.ReplaceLevelCourseGroups
}

// CourseGroupRelationsHandler handles course group-course relations.
type CourseGroupRelationsHandler struct {
	Validator      *validator.Validate
	AddCourseUC    catalog.AddCourseGroupCourse
	DeleteCourseUC catalog.DeleteCourseGroupCourse
	ReplaceUC      catalog.ReplaceCourseGroupCourses
}

type replaceCatalogRelationsRequest struct {
	Items []struct {
		ID    string `json:"id" validate:"required,uuid"`
		Order int    `json:"order" validate:"min=0,max=32767"`
	} `json:"items" validate:"required,min=1,dive"`
}

func mapCatalogRelationOrder(req replaceCatalogRelationsRequest) []domain.CatalogRelationOrder {
	items := make([]domain.CatalogRelationOrder, 0, len(req.Items))
	for _, item := range req.Items {
		items = append(items, domain.CatalogRelationOrder{ChildID: item.ID, Order: item.Order})
	}
	return items
}

func (h TrackRelationsHandler) AddLevel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req struct {
		LevelID string `json:"level_id" validate:"required,uuid"`
		Order   int    `json:"order" validate:"min=0,max=32767"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.AddLevelUC.Handle(r.Context(), catalog.AddTrackLevelInput{
		TrackID: chi.URLParam(r, "trackID"),
		LevelID: req.LevelID,
		Order:   req.Order,
	}); err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h TrackRelationsHandler) ReplaceLevels(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req replaceCatalogRelationsRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.ReplaceUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "trackID"), mapCatalogRelationOrder(req)); err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h TrackRelationsHandler) DeleteLevel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := h.DeleteLevelUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "trackID"), chi.URLParam(r, "levelID")); err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h LevelRelationsHandler) AddCourseGroup(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req struct {
		GroupID string `json:"group_id" validate:"required,uuid"`
		Order   int    `json:"order" validate:"min=0,max=32767"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.AddGroupUC.Handle(r.Context(), catalog.AddLevelCourseGroupInput{
		LevelID: chi.URLParam(r, "levelID"),
		GroupID: req.GroupID,
		Order:   req.Order,
	}); err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h LevelRelationsHandler) ReplaceCourseGroups(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req replaceCatalogRelationsRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.ReplaceUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "levelID"), mapCatalogRelationOrder(req)); err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h LevelRelationsHandler) DeleteCourseGroup(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := h.DeleteGroupUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "levelID"), chi.URLParam(r, "groupID")); err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h CourseGroupRelationsHandler) AddCourse(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req struct {
		CourseID string `json:"course_id" validate:"required,uuid"`
		Order    int    `json:"order" validate:"min=0,max=32767"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.AddCourseUC.Handle(r.Context(), catalog.AddCourseGroupCourseInput{
		GroupID:  chi.URLParam(r, "groupID"),
		CourseID: req.CourseID,
		Order:    req.Order,
	}); err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h CourseGroupRelationsHandler) ReplaceCourses(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req replaceCatalogRelationsRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.ReplaceUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "groupID"), mapCatalogRelationOrder(req)); err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h CourseGroupRelationsHandler) DeleteCourse(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := h.DeleteCourseUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "groupID"), chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")); err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}
